title: Future of Artificial Intelligence Innovation Act of 2024
last_action: Reported by the Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation with an amendment.
status: Reported by Senate committee; expired at the end of the 118th Congress
summary: Would have authorized federal artificial intelligence standards, metrics, evaluation tools, research capacity, and testbeds centered on NIST and the U.S. AI Safety Institute.
committee_dynamics: The bipartisan committee-reported bill would have supplied durable statutory support for federal AI evaluation capacity, but it did not reach enactment.
advance_rationale: The 118th Congress ended without enactment; any renewed effort requires a new measure in a later Congress.
verification_level: Official GovInfo text and legislative stage checked; end-of-Congress status applied
